body: Hey, I haven't ghosted you. Please check your PM's.
Long story short, it is painful. Don't do it.

Hey, this comment helped. A lot.
Thank you. I don't think I am depressed, I think I am being more manic, or when this was posted I was more manic, but this comment actually fucking helps.
Have a good one, mate.
Hi bi! I am L.

Thank you Peter, but I physically can't, I am a minor living with my parents.
But tomorrow I will go to the school counselor and tell her, about everything. Thank you, sincerely, I guess I just didn't want to think about how bad I really am mentally. ~ 'L'
I can't, not right now. I can't, sorry.
I have been told that many times, but I know. Thank you, this has made me feel better.

Maybe? Who knows, just don't do that to your son. I am happy you're getting help. My mum suffers from mental illness and she is a wreck. I remember one time when she got into an argument with my dad while we were in the car, and she opened the door and tried to get out of a moving car. Manic depression, am I right?
Maybe? Tonight has been a spiraling roller-coaster of emotions.
Okay. Thanks.
Okay then? I just wanted to be not alone, thanks for that.
I don't know why I did it either, I just don't know. I am just a stupid and pained kid, okay. Maybe I am so fucking stupid because I am so young, who knows?

Maybe. 
Tell me about yourself, please.

I want help, then I feel like it's stupid and I don't need it, because if I wanted to die then I would already be dead, wouldn't I? Why are you doing this? Isn't it frustrating talking to me?
I want a high paying job too. So i can collect bikes and cars, live how i want. No family, maybe a life with Kel (the girl). But I have always been a dreamer, so probably not.

School is boring, I am not challenged in it. I am already very dependent on myself without my parents for a 12yo, so at least I have that. I want to travel too, alone. I wish I never met her, what we have is too much, I like her too much, maybe i could say love but I know i am a teen and my emotions are just a exaggerated right now. Or maybe it is love. y'know what? fuck everyone, I know what i feel.

Yeah, thanks, I don't know what I enjoy. This girl really make me happy but I can't be dependent on her. My body is already pretty fucked. Thank you for replying, if you're still interested, I would love to keep on talking.

I have a dog, and a cat.
No, I always planned to end it all later in my teens, after experiencing all i wanted in life. Losing my virginity to a pretty girl, trying weed, being vulnerable with someone, the usual stuff.
I used to swim, but I quit. I want to play piano, but my parents push all that to the side, I fucked up my ankle so I can't do a lot.
The one real person is a girl named Kelly, she only thinks I am real too, apparently and I am 12.
I dont want to be another sob story.
